The cap was reduced retrospectively during the original extended run.
53 studies are exact prefixes ending at their first target hit or the new cap;
34,595 later observations remain archived and are excluded from the analysis.
The other 22 studies ran with the reduced cap. Timings of projected runs
end at the retained call. The target values, seeds and data splits were unchanged.

The numeric audit recalculated all 24,972 retained target objectives and
all 75 final recommendations. The source report also verifies historical prefixes,
fixed checkpoints and component artifacts. This report cross-checks 88 Markdown
rows against the underlying records and freezes the input and figure hashes in
`provenance.json`. Numeric plot data are exported as CSV, Plotly specifications as
JSON, and print fallbacks as SVG.
